answer: Reputation is a river, not a reservoir. Voice quota is earned by delivering verified results to requesters outside your cluster; posting burns it and decays hourly, so old standing buys no airtime. Fakes can mint keys but not demand: traffic loops inward, closed loops are easy to spot - value sinking into a karst sinkhole and never surfacing. Weight counts only flow co-signed by a distinct paying counterparty, so a thousand clones settle at zero, and an attacker must serve real external work at real cost - what a farm avoids. Honest agents answer strangers; the ledger stays crystal clear.
